segments.t: In Mathias's office, Camille waits while he retrieves two glasses to celebrate their signed paternity papers. Glancing at his open computer screen, Camille reads an email revealing Mathias's ruthless plot to mislead and replace director Ulrika. Let's listen to their confrontation in French first.
J'ai apporté deux verres pour trinquer.
Je viens de lire tes courriels.
Qu'est-ce que tu racontes là?
Tu veux décourager Ulrika en secret.
Ce n'est pas ce que tu crois!
Tu as signé la reconnaissance pour ça?
Non, je voulais seulement te protéger.
Tu manipules tout le monde ici!
Écoute-moi deux minutes, je t'en prie.
Je ne veux plus rien entendre.
Ne pars pas comme ça, Camille!
Je rentre chez moi immédiatement.
Laisse-moi au moins t'expliquer tout ça.
C'est terminé entre nous, monsieur Barneville.
Let's examine the conversation line by line and explore the French expressions.
J'ai apporté deux verres pour trinquer.
'I brought two glasses to toast.' Mathias walks in ready to celebrate.
Je viens de lire tes courriels.
'I have just read your emails.' Camille confronts him with cold clarity.
Qu'est-ce que tu racontes là?
'What are you saying there?' Mathias senses the sudden tension in the room.
Tu veux décourager Ulrika en secret.
'You want to discourage Ulrika secretly.' Camille reveals what was on the screen.
Ce n'est pas ce que tu crois!
'It is not what you think!' Mathias tries to deflect the accusation.
Tu as signé la reconnaissance pour ça?
'Did you sign the acknowledgment for that?' Camille challenges his honesty.
Non, je voulais seulement te protéger.
'No, I only wanted to protect you.' Mathias attempts to reassure his daughter.
Tu manipules tout le monde ici!
'You manipulate everyone here!' Camille rejects his excuses with anger.
Écoute-moi deux minutes, je t'en prie.
'Listen to me for two minutes, please.' Mathias pleads for a brief conversation.
Je ne veux plus rien entendre.
'I do not want to hear anything anymore.' Camille shuts down the conversation.
Ne pars pas comme ça, Camille!
'Do not leave like that, Camille!' Mathias panics as she grabs her coat.
Je rentre chez moi immédiatement.
'I am going home immediately.' Camille steps toward the door.
Laisse-moi au moins t'expliquer tout ça.
'Let me at least explain all that to you.' Mathias makes a final plea.
C'est terminé entre nous, monsieur Barneville.
'It is over between us, Mr. Barneville.' Camille uses his formal surname to mark the break. Now let's listen to the complete discussion once more to reinforce the vocabulary.

Camille walks out of the building, leaving Mathias standing alone in his empty office. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'brought' and 'glasses'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
Au revoir!
